beats.text: 404 Media ran the investigation itself, and its headline is the finding: "We tracked a shipment of rare books. It ended at an Amazon AI training facility." That is original reporting, not a rewrite of a press release. The method is the story: a hidden AirTag, Apple's own consumer tracker, used as a piece of journalism. Anyone watching this owns or can buy the same tool, which is what makes the result feel checkable rather than theoretical.
